UI_GamepadTweaks_steam_configDescription: Sticks and buttons work as a gamepad. Mod actions (horn, lights, drop items...) can be bound to any button, back paddle or combination.
UI_GamepadTweaks_Options_desc: Gamepad features of the mod. Turn one off to get the vanilla behaviour back. Bug fixes always work. Changes apply at once. More settings: Zomboid/GamepadTweaks.properties; button actions: Options -> Controller.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_enabled_to: Off: vanilla steering, everything below in this section is off.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_rawStick_t: The raw stick position steers, fine corrections work. Off: the game's stick value with its dead zone.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_recenter_t: A released stick rests slightly off zero and the car drives in an arc. The mod learns where the stick rests after a release and steers from there.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_scaleToSpe: Full stick = max angle at current speed
Vanilla limits the wheel angle at speed, so the outer part of the stick travel does nothing and small deflections are too sharp.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_highSpeedE: Steering curve at speed (2 = soft center)
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_highSpeedK: Speed for the curve at speed, km/h
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steering_constantRa: The wheels turn towards the stick at a constant rate. Vanilla lags more with speed (up to 3 s) and returns quickly only from inside the dead zone.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_triggers_noDeadZone: Vanilla applies the stick dead zone to the triggers too, so the first part of the travel does nothing (throttle, brake, map zoom).
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_actions_crouchOnPre: Vanilla toggles crouch on release, and not at all when held longer. Not used with the left stick radial menu.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_actions_sprintOnPre: Vanilla toggles sprint on release, and not at all when held longer.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_actions_vehicleOnly: Enter vehicles only with the A prompt
Vanilla also enters or exits any nearby vehicle on an Interact click, even when the button did something else.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_map_smooth_tooltip: The pan speed follows the stick, the zoom speed follows the triggers. Vanilla moves in steps.
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_map_panSpeed: Pan speed, map heights per second
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steamInput_enabled: Mod actions in the Steam controller configurator
UI_GamepadTweaks_opt_steamInput_enabled_: Bind mod actions to back paddles, long presses and chords in Steam. Needs a game restart.
